prompt: It is common for people to travel long distance for work and study.Some argue that longer commute times affect people in a negative way while others disagree. Discuss bothe views and give your opinion.
essay:
Some people argue that longer commute times harm individuals, while others believe they have few real drawbacks. This essay will discuss both views, but I believe the negative effects are more significant.

On the one hand, a long commute can damage both health and productivity. Crowded buses and trains are often uncomfortable, and the constant movement can make some passengers feel car sick. Even those who feel fine may arrive exhausted. For example, a student who spends two hours on public transport each morning may struggle to concentrate in the first class, and an employee may work less efficiently for the rest of the day. Over time, this daily fatigue can reduce both performance and general well-being.

On the other hand, a long commute is not entirely wasted time. Passengers on trains can read, listen to podcasts or review their lessons instead of simply waiting in traffic. A student, for instance, could revise vocabulary for an exam during the journey. Some people also use the trip to relax and separate home life from work, which helps them start the day more calmly. However, these benefits depend on finding a seat and a quiet environment, which cannot be guaranteed during rush hour.

In conclusion, although a long commute can offer some time for reading or relaxing, I believe the physical tiredness and stress it causes outweigh these advantages. Employers and schools could reduce the problem by offering more flexible hours.
